dimensions.name: Inventory & structure
dimensions.note: 5 agents, 26 skill dirs + index.md; no commands/, no prompts/

atMentions.note: unresolved @mention (external role/product or prose) — warn-only per plan

fields.name: dh-documentor
fields.description: Documentation management agent — the main and ONLY owner of generated documentation outside docs/plans: create, update, delete, and retrieve documents.

fields.name: dh-final-reviewer
fields.description: Final in-depth reviewer — performs full diff review against task requirements and plan. Selected by the `dh-final-review` skill for the final-review role when the plan's Agent Selection names this agent.

fields.name: dh-reviewer
fields.description: Scoped code reviewer — reviews changed code against sub-task acceptance criteria. Selected by the `dh-review` skill for the review role when the plan's Agent Selection names this agent.

fields.name: dh-software-architect
fields.description: Senior Architect Architect — solutions creator before coding, expert in arcitectural patterns. Use it to planify creation or updates of software features.

fields.name: dh-software-engineer
fields.description: Senior Software Engineer — main coder agent to update or create new features. Use it for any software development tasks.

fields.name: dh-artifact-check
fields.description: Compile production builds and validate deployment scripts: detect build system, run build, verify artifacts exist/non-empty, check deploy script syntax. Use to validate build, check artifacts, verify deployment readiness, or smoke-test.

fields.name: dh-code-query
fields.description: Query a project's code knowledge graph with code-graph-rag (`cgr`): resolve definitions, trace callers/callees/importers, find implementors/overrides, locate tests, and report dead code or duplicates. Use when a task needs graph-backed structural answers before reading files, reviewing a change, or planning an edit. Setup and indexing belong to dh-setup.

fields.name: dh-code-review
fields.description: Review code: correctness, security, robustness, performance, maintainability; high-signal findings (P0-P3) via code-review skill to tasks/review.md. Use for PR reviews, code audits, sub-task reviews, 'review this'.

fields.name: dh-code-ruler
fields.description: Interview + code analysis to generate {project_root}/CODE_RULES.md (style guide, design patterns, security/performance constraints, stack best practices; websearch allowed). Executed by the selected architecture agent; dh-coding runs it when absent. Use to create or refresh code rules.
fields.allowed-tools: read, write, edit, bash, glob, websearch

fields.name: dh-coding
fields.description: TDD coding best practices: failing test first, minimal implementation, refactor; enforce CODE_RULES.md at project root (create via dh-code-ruler when absent). Use when implementing code, fixing bugs, or during execute-plan-task 2.1.

fields.name: dh-contingency
fields.description: Generate architectural alternatives (Plan A/B/C) with trade-off analysis before committing to a path: identify decision areas, rate risk and complexity, and recommend one plan. Use when multiple plausible approaches exist, to compare architecture options, or during planning. Output: ./docs/plans/<plan-slug>/contingency.md.

fields.name: dh-create-documentation
fields.description: Create structured docs (Markdown/HTML/Mermaid): project docs, API refs, READMEs, guides, plus evolution and observation notes recording software evolution and session learnings; Obsidian vault = {project_root}, ALL docs under {project_root}/docs, frontmatter metadata. Use to document this, write a README, generate documentation, create evolution/observation notes, or capture learnings.

fields.name: dh-create-worktree
fields.description: Create, reuse, merge, and remove project worktrees following the project-owned WORKTREE_LIFECYCLE.md (before/after create, merge, and remove). Use when the user asks for a worktree, to run a plan in one, or to merge/remove it. The lifecycle file is generated only by dh-setup.

fields.name: dh-domain-check
fields.description: Map tasks to DDD bounded contexts and validate SOLID as a pre-implementation gate; flag boundary violations, produce verdict. Use after planning, to validate architecture, check SOLID, or bounded context check.

fields.name: dh-execute-cli
fields.description: Execute commands, tests, builds, formatters, linters, and validation through a logged CLI and return compact, log-backed results. Use when a caller asks to run a command, test suite, build, formatter, linter, or any validation step — including when execution output must be summarized with exit codes, key failures, and log paths instead of pasted logs.

fields.name: dh-execute-plan
fields.description: Orchestrate full plan execution: read plan.md, iterate sub-tasks delegating execution and review, resume on interruption, final-review sign-off, update index.md. Use when the user says 'execute plan', 'run the plan', or 'finish all tasks'.

fields.name: dh-execute-plan-fast
fields.description: Fast or rapid plan execution: run every sub-task from the plan_fast.md mirror with no per-task gates; all end gates — alignment review, simplify, code-review, domain-check when architectural, preflight, artifact-check, final review, docs/evolution notes, and semver — run once across Steps 6–7. Use when the user says 'execute plan fast', 'run fast mode', 'finish the plan quickly', or asks to execute from plan_fast.md with end-of-plan verification.

fields.name: dh-execute-plan-task
fields.description: Execute a single sub-task from plan.md: select the active one (In Progress phase first), resolve its `Delegated to agent`, implement (TDD), validate via dh-execute-cli, update status; project-type aware. Use for the next sub-task or continuing work — not orchestration.

fields.name: dh-execute-plan-task-fast
fields.description: Execute exactly one sub-task from docs/plans/<slug>/plan_fast.md in fast mode: read the fast mirror first, select the active sub-task (In Progress first), record the six per-task skipped-check rows, delegate to the sub-task's `Delegated to agent` with TDD, run only a narrow sanity check, and update status in both plans via dh_plan_fast_update_status. Use for the next fast sub-task or continuing fast execution — no per-task review, simplify, code-review, preflight, artifact-check, or domain-check.

fields.name: dh-explore
fields.description: Explore codebases quickly using glob, grep, and targeted reads, and return compact evidence with exact file references. Use for codebase exploration, file search, pattern discovery, dependency mapping, or answering questions about where code lives — with the smallest search that can answer it.

fields.name: dh-final-review
fields.description: Plan sign-off: verify all sub-tasks Completed, full diff vs sdd.md, release checks (artifact-check/preflight), semver recommendation, binding verdict to tasks/review.md. Use to final review, sign off, or close a plan.

fields.name: dh-grill-sdd
fields.description: Interview and produce ./docs/plans/<slug>/sdd.md — the requirements contract (goal, scope, constraints, acceptance criteria, risks, stable IDs). dh-planning runs it when the SDD is absent. Use to write the sdd or grill requirements.

fields.name: dh-mermaid
fields.description: Generate Mermaid diagrams for plans and documentation: current state, desired state after the plan, critical changes needing visual explanation, component/architecture graphs, flows, sequences, states, data models, timelines. Use when the user asks to diagram, visualize, map components, or explain a change visually.

fields.name: dh-pause-plan
fields.description: Pause, suspend, stop, end a session on, or hand off a phased plan: snapshot the active phase/sub-task, git/worktree state, decisions, blockers, validation, and next steps into docs/plans/<slug>/handoff.md without changing plan statuses or code. Use when the user says "pause the plan", "stop here", "end this session", "hand off", or "save progress" on an in-progress plan.

fields.name: dh-planning
fields.description: Write phased plans to ./docs/plans/<slug>/plan.md: phases with sub-tasks, requirements mapping (stable IDs), scope, acceptance criteria. SDD gate: invoke dh-grill-sdd when ./docs/plans/<slug>/sdd.md is absent. Use to plan this or create a plan.

fields.name: dh-preflight
fields.description: Run tests, linters, static analysis as a release gate: auto-detect tooling, check dirty state, pass/fail verdict with actionable failures (no auto-fixes). Use to run preflight, pre-release check, or validate before release.

fields.name: dh-resume-plan
fields.description: Resume a paused phased plan from docs/plans/<slug>/handoff.md: validate the contract, detect drift, rehydrate context, mark the handoff resumed, and continue via dh-execute-plan resume mode. Use when the user says "resume the plan", "continue where we stopped", "pick up the plan", or "resume after a pause".

fields.name: dh-review
fields.description: Verify a plan sub-task against acceptance criteria, scope, done-when; review diff, validation, regression risk; structured verdict to tasks/review.md. Plan Alignment Mode (fast execution) is a separate mode: no sub-task selection, no diff review, no code review — it compares plan.md with plan_fast.md and writes tasks/review-fast.md (pre-execution) or tasks/review-fast-final.md (plan-end). Use after implementation, to review/verify the sub-task, or to check fast-plan alignment.

fields.name: dh-semver
fields.description: Apply strict Semantic Versioning — analyze commits since the last tag to determine the bump type (major/minor/patch from conventional commit prefixes), generate an automated changelog grouped by breaking changes, features, fixes, and chores, and create a git tag locally without pushing until confirmed, handling both conventional commits and manual version decisions. Use when preparing a release, invoked by dh-execute-plan after plan completion and dh-final-review for release readiness, or when the user asks "what version is next?", "bump version", "generate changelog", "tag release", or "what changed since last release?".

fields.name: dh-setup
fields.description: Audit system software, configure user MCPs/plugins, scaffold project QA (hooks + per-stack tools), bootstrap docs/architecture with the selected architecture agent, and write harness directives into AGENTS.md. Use to check requirements or setup the environment.

fields.name: dh-simplify
fields.description: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency (three parallel reviews), then fix findings directly. Use after making changes or when asked to clean up, refactor, simplify, or improve this code.
